changelog.name: Pixel Suite 3.1.0
changelog.body:
# Pixel Suite 3.1.0

**Pixel Suite now speaks 14 languages**, and brings Backup & Restore for held-back apps, new button actions, a new icon and, for patrons, Chrome+, Gboard+ and a built-in VPN.

---

## ✨ Highlights

- 💾 **Backup & Restore** for held-back apps, with their data
- 🌍 **14 languages**, this changelog included
- 🎮 **Pixel Stack!**, a little hidden game
- 🔘 **New button actions** for the power and volume buttons
- 🧹 **Hide the search bar** with one hold
- 💎 **Chrome+, Gboard+ and a built-in VPN** for patrons

---

## 💾 Backup & Restore

- 🛡️ **Held-back apps are saved before they update**, with their data (sign-ins, chats, settings and files) or the app only.
- 🗂️ **The 3 newest versions** of each app are kept, even after you uninstall it.
- 📋 **Back up any app yourself**, the app only or with all its data, and restore it whenever you like. Tap the **green button** to put a saved version back.

*In Protection › OTA & Store blocker › Play Store blocker.*

---

## 🌍 14 languages

- 🗣️ Pixel Suite now speaks **Chinese, Hindi, Spanish, Arabic, French, Portuguese, Russian, Bengali, Indonesian, German, Japanese, Turkish, Persian and Hebrew**, this changelog included.
- 📍 It follows your phone's language, or tap the **language pill** at the top right of the home page to pick one.
- ↔️ Arabic, Persian and Hebrew read right to left.

---

## 🎮 Pixel Stack!

- 🧱 **Hold the logo** at the top of Pixel Suite's home page for a little hidden game.
- 🎯 Stack the blocks as high as you can, and land them exactly for **Perfect!**
- 📣 **Share your score** with our Telegram community!

---

## 🔘 Buttons

- 🔘 **Hold power button**: open Gemini or Circle to Search, take a screenshot, or switch a quiet mode on and off: Silence, Do Not Disturb, Do Not Annoy, or No Annoyance for all three.
- 🔒 **Hold power button when locked**: pick a different action for when your phone is locked: Gemini (stock), Silence, Do Not Disturb, Do Not Annoy or No Annoyance. It works on its own, apart from Hold power button.
- 📷 **Double-press power button**: now you can also choose Camera (stock).
- 🔦 **Double-press volume down**: now you can also turn the flashlight on or off.

*In Shortcuts › Buttons.*

---

## ✨ Also new

- 🧹 **Hide search bar**: simply hold the search bar and choose **Hide widget**. The dock moves down, your apps use the space, and search stays in the app drawer. *(or Personalize › Pixel Launcher)*
- 🕒 **Always-on display**: keep it on while charging, and let the power button show it for a few seconds when you turn the screen off. *(Personalize › Always-on display)*
- 🔢 **Auto-confirm 4-digit PIN**: your phone unlocks as soon as you type the 4th digit, no Enter needed. *(Protection › Privacy & Security › Lock screen)*
- 🔎 **Search in Chrome**: select text in any app, tap ⋮ and choose **Search in Chrome**. The words open straight into Chrome.
- 🗑️ **Only Clear all**: recents shows just Clear all, in the middle, without Select and Screenshot. *(Personalize › Pixel Launcher › Recent Apps)*
- 🎨 **New Pixel Suite icon**: it fills the circle edge to edge, without the white plate, and has a themed version that follows your wallpaper colours.

---

## 💎 Patreon

### 🚀 Chrome+

- 🚀 **Controls at the bottom**, with smoother hand-crafted animations for tabs, the tab switcher and new tabs.
- 🕶️ **Incognito in one tap**: the orange + in the tab switcher opens an incognito tab.
- 🧩 **Extensions**: VPN, Ad Blocker and Dark pages in one sheet, from the puzzle button in Chrome's toolbar. Tap one to use it, or hold it to pin it to the toolbar.
- 🛡️ **Ad Blocker**: pick a filtering level for each website. Complete also hides cookie banners and pop-ups, and you can remove any part of a page yourself. Its switch in the Extensions sheet turns it off or on for every website.
- 🌙 **Dark pages**: websites open dark with no white flash, or pure black with Super Dark: always, with your phone's dark mode, or on a schedule. Pictures and videos keep their colours.
- ⭐ **Speed dial**: round icons for up to 19 websites on Chrome's new tab page. Drag to move them, or drop one on another to make a folder that follows Super Dark. Give any website your own round picture.

*In Patreon › Google apps › Chrome+.*

### 🌐 VPN

- 🌍 **Browse from another country** on open-source servers worldwide, with the fastest server first.
- 📱 **For the whole phone or Chrome only.** Chrome's location follows the VPN.

*In Patreon › VPN, or from its Quick Settings tile.*

### ⌨️ Gboard+

- ⌨️ **Your own toolbar**: up to 7 shortcuts, like Undo, Redo, Quick Select, Select all, Cut, Copy and Paste, in every app. Select all and Quick Select open the Copy and Paste menu right away.
- 🔤 **Rounded keys** with smooth pop-ups. Swipe left from delete to remove letter by letter.
- ↕️ **Resize or move the keyboard.** With Gboard's number row on, the symbols page keeps the same key size.
- ✍️ **Auto-correction off** for the languages you choose.
- 📎 **Keep every clip** in the clipboard.
- 🎙️ **Voice typing with checkmark**: speak, then tap the checkmark to add your words.
- 🧊 **Frosted Gboard**: the keyboard's background turns to frosted glass: what's behind it shows through, blurred, with the glass rims, in light, dark and Super Dark. The keys stay as they are.

*In Patreon › Google apps › Gboard+.*

### 📞 Google dialer+

- 🎙️ **Recording quality**: Standard for smaller files, HD for a clearer voice (now the default), or Lossless for the clearest.

*In Patreon › Google apps › Google dialer+.*

---

## 🪄 Polish

- 🌑 **Super Dark**: the menu over selected text (Cut, Copy, Search in Chrome and more) is now black with a rim in every app, and Chrome's incognito stays pure black everywhere, also while switching tabs.
- ⚡ **Options apply on their own**: Super Dark-Mode and the surface style change as you switch them, other options restart their own app, and the Refresh pill only shows for Pixel Launcher options.
- 🔄 **Reboot pill**: some features only start working after a reboot. After you update, a Reboot pill shows until your phone restarts. Tap it to see which features need the reboot, then tap again to reboot.
- 🌄 **Google feed**: swipe right on the home screen and the feed slides in over your wallpaper, with no white panel flashing first.
- 🏠 **Pixel Launcher**: holding the search bar now shows only Widget settings and Hide widget.

---

## 🐞 Bug fixes

### 🏠 Pixel Launcher

- 🧠 **No more slowdowns**: after many switches between light and dark (a dark mode schedule, say), it could slow down, stop responding and restart. It stays smooth now.
- 🖐️ **App menus**: holding an app at some home screen spots showed only a few small icons, and its menu vanished. Menus open fully everywhere now.
- 🔴 **Folder dots**: in the app drawer, folder notification dots floated above their folders on some Pixel Launcher versions. They sit on the folders again.
- 🪟 **Frosted Glass menus**: the row of icons at the top of an app's menu showed before the rest. It fades in with the menu now.

### 📱 Navigation buttons

- 🏠 **Swipe home**: after you turned the screen, swiping up to go home could stop working when the Back button was on. It works every time now.
- 🧭 **Bottom menus**: some apps put their bottom menu under the buttons. It sits above them now.

*In Shortcuts › Gestures › Navigation buttons.*

### 🌐 Chrome

- 🛟 **Ad Blocker**: Chrome could close by itself if you left a page or closed a tab while it was still loading. It stays open now.
- 📰 **Chrome feed**: the feed could jump while sponsored stories were hidden. It stays put now and scrolls more smoothly.

### ⌨️ Keyboard & Super Dark

- #️⃣ **Number keys**: in Super Dark, Gboard's number keys (for PINs, phone numbers and amounts) were black on black and didn't light up when tapped. They show and light up again.
- ➗ **Gboard+ numbers page**: the + - * / column now matches the other keys. The space and delete keys look like keys again and no longer disappear in dark mode.
- 🔔 **Notifications**: in Super Dark, one-line notifications at the bottom of the shade stayed grey. They're Super Dark now.
- ✅ **Select apps**: the keyboard stayed open over the list after you ticked an app from search. It closes now.

---

## 📥 Install

1. Install **PixelSuite-v3.1.0.apk** over your current version.
2. Reboot (the Reboot pill in Pixel Suite does it for you).

New in 3.0.0? See the [3.0.0 release notes](https://github.com/RovianDev/PixelSuite/blob/main/RELEASE-NOTES-v3.0.0.md) for everything that came with it.

[GitHub releases](https://github.com/RovianDev/PixelSuite/releases) · [Xposed releases](https://github.com/Xposed-Modules-Repo/io.github.roviandev.pixelsuite/releases)

changelog.name: Pixel Suite 3.0.2
changelog.body:
# Pixel Suite 3.0.2

A share menu you can arrange by hand, app drawer folders you can place anywhere, and icon pack fixes.

## ✨ New

- 📤 **Share menu, your way:** drag an app into the top row to pin it, then drag your pinned apps into the order you want. The apps below keep your chosen order instead of being rearranged by suggestions. Newly installed apps join the bottom of the list.
- 👆 **Hold to pin or hide:** hold an app in the share menu to open its Pin / Hide window. If it has several shortcuts, they appear between Pin and Hide; tap the arrow under the app to open them directly. Pinning or hiding keeps the app and its shortcuts together as one app.
- 📁 **Place drawer folders anywhere:** hold a folder in the app drawer and drag it among your apps. The apps glide aside to make room, and the folder lands with a gentle bounce.
- ⬇️ **Move to bottom:** a pill appears at the bottom while you drag a drawer folder. Touch it to start scrolling down, then push deeper into the bottom area to scroll faster. Drag toward the top edge to scroll upward in the same way.
- ✌️ **Two-finger drag for folders:** while holding a folder, swipe with a second finger to scroll the list.
- 🧹 **Clear badge:** hold an app or folder with a notification dot, then choose Clear badge. Notifications that can be dismissed are cleared. Notifications that cannot be dismissed remain, but stop showing a dot.

## 💎 Polish

- ✨ **Share menu:** pinning, unpinning and hiding apps are way smoother, with apps gliding into place and the menu resizing without jumps or flicker.
- 🗂️ **Share menu:** the Hidden apps panel groups each app with its own shortcuts and icons.
- 🎯 **App drawer:** dropping an app or folder now lands with a soft bounce, and nearby apps give way slightly.
- 🏠 **App drawer:** the Add to home screen pill sits slightly higher, to prevent accidentally adding apps or folders to the home screen.
- 🎨 **Icon packs:** the pack list and the per-app icon picker have more spacing, so selections no longer touch.

## 🐞 Bug fixes

- **App drawer:** folders now show a notification dot when an app inside has notifications.
- **Icon packs:** see-through icon packs now stay see-through, with no white or black disc behind them, and icons are no longer cut off at the edges.
- **App drawer:** on some Pixel Launcher versions, folder backgrounds no longer flash when you open or close them.
- **Screen recording:** the Start and close panel no longer flashes or flickers with Frosted Glass.
- **Hide Developer Options:** USB debugging is now hidden more thoroughly, even from apps that aren't ticked in LSPosed.

## 🛠️ Google & Pixel bugs fixed

- **Pixel Launcher:** some app icons had clipped corners and rough edges. They're clean now.

## Install

1. Install **PixelSuite-v3.0.2.apk** over your current version.
2. Reboot.

New in 3.0.0? See the [3.0.0 release notes](RELEASE-NOTES-v3.0.0.md) for everything that came with it.

changelog.name: Pixel Suite 3.0.0
changelog.body:
# Pixel Suite 3.0.0

**The biggest Pixel Suite release yet.** 3.0.0 brings a smarter share menu, a reimagined Pixel Studio, icon packs, call recording, system-wide ad blocking, Do Not Annoy, OTA & Play Store blockers, navigation buttons and much more, shaped across 191 preview builds. It also fixes bugs in Google's own apps, works with more Pixel Launcher versions, and gives the Pixel Suite app a fresh new look.

---

## ✨ Highlights

- 📤 **Share menu tools:** reorder pinned apps and contacts, hide apps and contacts into folders
- 🖼️ **Pixel Studio, reimagined:** zoom, an all-new text tool, the whole picture after a crop, floating colour menu
- 🎨 **Icon packs** for Pixel Launcher, in your icon shape
- 📞 **Call recording** in the Google Phone app, in any country, without the announcement
- 🚫 **Ad blocking** system-wide, in Chrome and Google News, plus an ad-free Google feed
- 🔕 **Do Not Annoy:** silence incoming calls while staying connected
- 🛡️ **OTA & Store blocker:** keep your system and chosen apps on their current versions
- ⌚ **Pixel Watch eSIM** setup with a QR code, in any country
- 🧭 **Navigation buttons** beside the gesture bar
- 🍞 **Toasts:** choose where every toast appears
- 📱 **More Pixel Launchers supported**, and fixes for bugs in Google's own apps

---

## 📤 Share menu (Share menu > Share sheet tools)

- **Reorder pinned apps** by dragging; extra pinned rows when one is full. Pinned apps aren't listed twice.
- **Hide apps** into a **Hidden apps** folder, one by one or several at once with **Edit**. Tap a hidden app to share to it; long-press to unhide.
- **Contacts:** reorder pinned contacts, hide contacts into a **Hidden contacts** folder, or fold the whole contacts row away.
- Long app names stay on one line. Folders and panels follow your surface style and theme.
- Google Photos' share page now uses the share sheet's own colours instead of plain white.

---

## 🖼️ Pixel Studio, reimagined

- **Zoom:** pinch to zoom up to 5x and pan, anywhere in the editor. While zoomed, the pen, highlighter and eraser draw right under your finger, and crop corners stay under it. Save and Share are unaffected.
- **All-new text tool:** type right on the picture, live, in your chosen font and colour.
  - Only ✓ saves, in the top bar or on the text's frame; ✕ deletes.
  - A saved text keeps a frame: drag to move it, side handles re-wrap the words, corner handles resize it. Two fingers on a text zoom the picture, like anywhere else.
  - A floating fonts and colours menu above the tool bar or keyboard, compact or full width, that you can drag or flick.
  - Typing on a cropped picture shows the cropped part right above the keyboard.
- **The whole picture after a crop:** other tools keep the picture in place, the cropped part where the box was and the rest softly blurred around it.
- **Crop from any tool:** grab a crop corner from any page and keep dragging.
- **Pen stays inside the crop:** after a crop, strokes stay within the cropped area.
- **Floating colour menu** for the pen and highlighter, in the style of the Doodles menu.
- **The tool bar is always there**, also while a text or sticker is selected.
- **Pen strokes on top** of texts, stickers and Doodles' shapes, on screen and when saved.
- **Sticker grabbers:** resize stickers from their corners, with undo.
- One menu at a time: the pen, colour, text and Doodles menus close each other.
- Doodles: two fingers now zoom and pan the picture; small shapes move without growing. After a crop, new shapes are drawn only inside the cropped part (existing ones can still be moved anywhere).
- Crop only from the four corners, so swiping in from an edge no longer crops by accident.

The new text tool needs Pixel Studio 2.3.001; on other versions, Pixel Studio's own text tool is used.

---

## 🎨 Icons

**Icon packs** (Themes > Choose Icon pack)
- Use any standard icon pack from the Play Store or sideloaded (ADW / Nova / Lawnchair format).
- Covers the home screen, folders, the dock, the app drawer and drawer search.
- Every pack icon is trimmed and cut into the icon shape you chose in Wallpaper & style, with clean, smooth edges in every shape.
- Apps the pack doesn't include keep their own icons, including themed icons. Packs that use Material You colours follow your phone's colours.
- Changes apply live with a smooth crossfade, no launcher restart. Icons are prepared in advance, so scrolling stays smooth.
- Pick one app's icon from any pack: long-press the app > **Change icon** > **Icon pack**, with search and the app's matching icons first. **Reset icon** goes back.

**Colorful icons in the app drawer (Stock)** (Themes > Change icons)
- An option for a stock-looking drawer: with themed icons on, the app drawer, its suggestions, drawer search and drawer folders keep each app's own colours. The home screen stays themed.

---

## 💎 Google apps (Patreon)

Support Pixel Suite on Patreon and sign in inside the app to unlock these. Locked features are clearly marked and stay off until unlocked.

- **📞 Call recording** in the Google Phone app: works in any country, automatic or manual, and without the "This call is now being recorded" announcement. A copy of each recording is saved as M4A, named after the contact and time, in Recordings/Calls or a folder you choose.
- **🚫 Ad blocker:** blocks ad and tracker domains for every app and browser, even with Private DNS on, using the HaGeZi Multi LIGHT, AdAway and EasyList lists, updated daily.
  - **Chrome:** ads on web pages are hidden with EasyList's element rules, so no empty boxes or gaps are left. "Allow ads" and "turn off your ad blocker" pop-ups, sticky ad bars and floating video ads are removed too, and the page scrolls normally again.
  - **Chrome's new-tab feed:** sponsored stories disappear completely as you scroll, and so do the "Is this a good recommendation for you?" prompts.
  - **Google News:** cleaner articles, without ads.
- **📰 Hide ads in Google feed:** sponsored cards in Discover (and the launcher's left page) disappear completely, frame and gap included.

The pass is checked on your phone and works within seconds, no restart.

---

## 🔕 Do Not Annoy

Silence every incoming call while your phone stays connected. Data, Wi-Fi, outgoing calls and messages keep working.
- On Pixels with Pixel's calling stack (Pixel 10 and later), callers hear that your phone is switched off or unavailable. On other phones, calls are declined.
- Emergency calls always ring.
- Each silenced call shows a notification with a **Call back** button and a call log entry.
- Quick Settings tile included.
- **Pixel Watch with LTE:** also turns your watch's own mobile network off and back on, with the **Pixel Suite Watch** app (separate download).

---

## 🛡️ OTA & Store blocker

- **OTA blocker:** stops system update checks and downloads, and removes Software updates from Settings. **Lock factory reset** greys out Erase all data while it's on.
- **Play Store blocker:** chosen apps stay on their current version; the Play Store never updates them. Core Pixel apps are held back unless you choose **Unlock OEM apps**, and uninstalling or disabling them asks for your fingerprint or PIN.

---

## ⌚ Pixel Watch eSIM

**eSIM setup with a QR code** (Google apps > Pixel watch): the Pixel Watch app offers **Scan QR code** under Mobile network, even where Google says "No carrier supported". A one-time $10 purchase, yours to keep on your phone; Patreon is not required.

---

## 🧭 Navigation buttons (Gestures > Navigation buttons)

A hybrid navigation bar: the gesture pill stays, with a button on each side.
- Choose the left and right buttons: **Back**, **Home**, **Recent apps** or none.
- **Hold Home for:** Circle to Search, Gemini or nothing.
- Buttons follow the pill's light and dark colour and hide on the lock screen.
- With the keyboard open, the Back arrow turns down to close it.
- Swipes from the pill still go Home and to Recents. Taps are instant, with roomy touch areas.

---

## 🍞 Toasts (Pixel Launcher > Toasts)

Choose where every toast message appears: **Top** (as before), **Middle**, or **Bottom (Stock)**, where Android puts it. All toasts follow your choice, in your surface style and theme.

---

## ⚙️ Miscellaneous

- **Refresh rate slider:** a 60 / 120 Hz slider under Smooth display in Settings > Display & touch. The screen still drops to its lowest rate when nothing moves.
- **Show FPS:** a live frame counter at the top right for the app in front.
- **Backup & restore** (About and support): save your whole setup to one file (every setting, drawer folders and sorting, renamed apps, custom icons and share menu choices) and restore it anytime, even after clearing Pixel Launcher's storage or a factory reset. Patreon sign-in and the eSIM purchase aren't included; they stay tied to your account, and Patreon features only switch back on with an active Patreon pass.
- **Allow screenshots of secure screens** and **Hide accessibility from apps** are now built entirely on Pixel Suite's own code, with the same behaviour.

---

## 💠 A fresh look

- **Pixel Suite app redesign:** a new home header, colour-coded sections, **search across every setting**, panels that fit the screen, soft frosted scrolling edges, and an **LSPosed scope** guide on each feature page that lists exactly which apps to select.
- **Super Dark-Mode, deeper:** the app's sheets, dialogs, menus and fields share one pure-black palette, and pills and toasts are white on black.
- **Glass rims:** Frosted Glass panels, folders, menus, toasts and dialogs get a soft glass edge in light and dark theme, and Super Dark's soft rim in Super Dark-Mode, now also on Settings pop-ups. Blur Off keeps plain panels.
- **Soft frosted scrolling edges (Frosted Glass)** across the whole Settings app and the screens it opens (Google, Wallpaper & style, Permissions, Digital Wellbeing, Pixel Troubleshooting, Personal Safety), and in the app drawer, where apps fade softly under the search bar as you scroll.
- The app drawer always shows its **All apps** label under the suggestions.
- Open folders show their name in bold, on the left, and folders in the app drawer lift when you hold them, like apps.
- **Remove, Cancel and Uninstall** light up with an outline as an app reaches them, one at a time. Several selected apps fly into them together.

---

## 📱 More Pixel Launchers supported

Pixel Suite now works across more Pixel Launcher versions, including the newest builds with the redesigned app menu. Every feature is loaded on its own, so if a launcher version changes something one feature relies on, the others keep working.
- Pixel Suite's menu options (Create folder, Change icon, Rename, Lock) show on the new Pixel Launcher menu, and Hide app shortcuts works there too.
- Fixed a Pixel Launcher crash when opening an app's menu on newer launcher builds.
- Fixed dragging apps out of the app list, drawer folders and icon label sizing on newer launcher builds.
- Clear all, folder reordering, locked-app and folder protection, and the home screen's **Pixel Suite settings** row are adapted to the changes in newer launcher builds.

---

## 🐞 Bug fixes

- Pixel Studio: after typing a text and pressing ✓, opening Doodles or another tool could add a copy of the text.
- Double tap to sleep: right after a reboot, typing your PIN could turn the screen off.
- Custom and icon-pack icons: swiping an app away no longer briefly shows the stock icon flying back.
- Custom and icon-pack icons: a closed folder's small icons no longer snap to the themed icons at the end of the closing animation.
- Pixel Launcher: after moving several apps at once, Remove or Cancel could overlap Uninstall on the next drag.

---

## 🛠️ Google & Pixel bugs fixed

Bugs in Google's own apps that Pixel Suite now fixes:
- **Pixel Launcher:** themed icons had hard, stepped edges with a thin light rim in every icon shape. They're now drawn smooth, like normal icons.
- **Pixel Launcher:** closing a folder from its second (or later) page with a non-round icon shape (arch, cookie, clover…) blanked the page while the first page's icons trailed outside the folder. Folders now close cleanly from any page, in every shape.
- **Pixel Studio:** dragging a crop corner made a selected text jump around. It stays still now.
- **Pixel Studio:** tapping a text or sticker on the crop page threw away your crop. Your crop is kept.
- **Pixel Studio:** the tool bar disappeared while a text or sticker was selected. It stays.
- **Pixel Studio:** picking a pen could fold the tool bar down to that one pen. Fixed.
- **Pixel Studio:** selecting a text or sticker covered the pen strokes drawn before it. Strokes stay visible.

---

## 🔒 Privacy

Pixel Suite has no ads, analytics or tracking, and the module itself never connects to the internet. The Pixel Suite app goes online only for:
- checking for Pixel Suite updates on GitHub (you can turn this off);
- downloading the Ad blocker's lists, while the Ad blocker is on;
- Patreon sign-in and pass renewal, if you sign in;
- the eSIM purchase: activation, restore and an occasional licence check, if you buy it.

Doodles, screenshots, photos, call recordings and your share menu choices stay on your phone. Do Not Annoy talks to your watch over a private Bluetooth connection.

---

## 📥 Install and scope

**Root + LSPosed API 102 required.** Tested on Pixel 11 Pro with Android 17.

1. Install **PixelSuite-v3.0.0.apk** over your current version.
2. Open Pixel Suite and turn on what you like. Each feature page has an **LSPosed scope** section listing the apps to select.
3. Select those apps in LSPosed, then reboot.

New scopes in 3.0.0, only for the features you use: Chrome (web page and feed ads), Phone (call recording), Share sheet (share menu tools), Play Store (Play Store blocker), Pixel Watch (eSIM), IMS Stack and Phone Services (Do Not Annoy), your keyboard (navigation buttons), and Google Play services, Wallpaper & style, Digital Wellbeing, Permission Controller, Personal Safety and Pixel Troubleshooting (soft frosted edges in Settings and the screens it opens).

Call recording may be restricted by your country's laws. Obtain any required consent before recording.

changelog.name: Pixel Suite v2.0.8
changelog.body:
# Pixel Suite v2.0.8

A polish and bug-fix update for the screenshot editor, launcher folders and recents, including fixes for bugs in Pixel Studio and Pixel Launcher themselves.

## ✨ New
- **Crop blur (Pixel Studio):** cropping now blurs the part you're cutting away, live as you drag, instead of just dimming it. Drag back out and it's sharp again.
- **Outlined crop corners:** the four corner marks have an outline, so they're easy to see on light and dark screenshots, in your theme's colour.
- **Undo for drawer folders:** removing a drawer folder now shows "Item removed  Undo", like the home screen. Undo puts it back with its apps, name, grid, sort and lock.

## 🎨 Polish
- Pixel Studio, Frosted Glass (light theme): the tool bar, pen size bar, font bar, trash button and Doodles menu now share one frost, and open with their final look, with no shade shift or blink.
- Pixel Studio: Undo stays faded until there's something to undo. Redo is always shown clearly.
- Pixel Studio: tapping another tool (pen, highlighter, eraser, crop, text) closes Doodles at once.

# Pixel Suite v1.1.3

Improved double-tap wake that adapts to how the phone is resting, with better handling of soft taps, pickup and missed attempts.

## What changed

- **Better wake detection in your hand or on your lap.** The held/still check also recognizes a phone resting on your thigh. While held, the touchscreen stays touch-active on the always-on display so both taps can be real touches.
- **Bounded held-touch periods.** Held mode runs for up to 90 seconds per stretch, with a regular four-minute budget per lock. After a missed tap, a short recovery can re-arm touch while the phone is held.
- **Low-power behavior when resting still.** On a desk or nightstand, the always-on display returns to low-power mode and motion readings help detect the second tap. An extra tap within three seconds is a backup if a quick double tap misses.
- **Softer second taps** are detected more readily on a still phone.
- **Pickup and charging fixes.** Better handling of taps just after pickup and small shifts while charging.
- **Lockscreen interaction fix.** Delayed touch events are handled to prevent a double tap from opening lockscreen customization unexpectedly.

## Why this approach is better

Touch detection is used where motion-based detection is less dependable, such as a held phone or one resting on a lap. When the phone is still, the display can return to low-power operation instead of keeping the touchscreen touch-active throughout standby.

Movement, very soft taps and a vibrating car mount can still affect detection. The held-mode budget also limits how long touch stays active; this is not a guarantee that every double tap will register in every position.

## Testing and battery

Tested on my Pixel 11 Pro with Android 17 and LSPosed API 102. It is working well in my testing so far, and I have not noticed additional battery drain. No measured overnight percentage is available; this is not a claim of zero power use. Other devices remain untested.

- **Fixed:** a double tap to wake right after locking could be missed while the lock screen was still coming up.
- **Lighter on battery:** the lock screen touch listener now only runs while the lock screen can show (before, it saw every touch all day), the three-finger screenshot listener only runs while that feature is on, the flashlight shares Pixel Suite's background thread instead of keeping its own, and internal lookups and Files sorting are cached.
- **Fixed:** in the module's settings screen, a switch flipped while the screen was reloading could jump back.

Install the APK over the previous version (no uninstall needed) and reboot. Tested on a Pixel 11 Pro running Android 17 with LSPosed (API 102).

# Pixel Suite 3.0.2

Your Pixel. Your way.

Made by **RovianDev**. An open-source LSPosed module for Pixel phones: launcher customization and icon packs, navigation buttons, app and folder locks, gestures, screenshot tools, share menu tools, call recording, ad blocking and more. Every feature has its own switch.

**Open Pixel Suite from your home screen:** touch and hold an empty area, then choose **Pixel Suite settings**.

[📥 GitHub download](https://github.com/RovianDev/PixelSuite/releases) · [📥 Xposed download](https://github.com/Xposed-Modules-Repo/io.github.roviandev.pixelsuite/releases) · [Full 3.0.0 release notes](RELEASE-NOTES-v3.0.0.md) · [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md)

## What's new in 3.0.2

A share menu you can arrange by hand, app drawer folders you can place anywhere, and icon pack fixes.

### ✨ New

- 📤 **Share menu, your way:** drag an app into the top row to pin it, then drag your pinned apps into the order you want. The apps below keep your chosen order instead of being rearranged by suggestions. Newly installed apps join the bottom of the list.
- 👆 **Hold to pin or hide:** hold an app in the share menu to open its Pin / Hide window. If it has several shortcuts, they appear between Pin and Hide; tap the arrow under the app to open them directly. Pinning or hiding keeps the app and its shortcuts together as one app.
- 📁 **Place drawer folders anywhere:** hold a folder in the app drawer and drag it among your apps. The apps glide aside to make room, and the folder lands with a gentle bounce.
- ⬇️ **Move to bottom:** a pill appears at the bottom while you drag a drawer folder. Touch it to start scrolling down, then push deeper into the bottom area to scroll faster. Drag toward the top edge to scroll upward in the same way.
- ✌️ **Two-finger drag for folders:** while holding a folder, swipe with a second finger to scroll the list.
- 🧹 **Clear badge:** hold an app or folder with a notification dot, then choose Clear badge. Notifications that can be dismissed are cleared. Notifications that cannot be dismissed remain, but stop showing a dot.

### 💎 Polish

- ✨ **Share menu:** pinning, unpinning and hiding apps are way smoother, with apps gliding into place and the menu resizing without jumps or flicker.
- 🗂️ **Share menu:** the Hidden apps panel groups each app with its own shortcuts and icons.
- 🎯 **App drawer:** dropping an app or folder now lands with a soft bounce, and nearby apps give way slightly.
- 🏠 **App drawer:** the Add to home screen pill sits slightly higher, to prevent accidentally adding apps or folders to the home screen.
- 🎨 **Icon packs:** the pack list and the per-app icon picker have more spacing, so selections no longer touch.

### 🐞 Bug fixes

- **App drawer:** folders now show a notification dot when an app inside has notifications.
- **Icon packs:** see-through icon packs now stay see-through, with no white or black disc behind them, and icons are no longer cut off at the edges.
- **App drawer:** on some Pixel Launcher versions, folder backgrounds no longer flash when you open or close them.
- **Screen recording:** the Start and close panel no longer flashes or flickers with Frosted Glass.
- **Hide Developer Options:** USB debugging is now hidden more thoroughly, even from apps that aren't ticked in LSPosed.

### 🛠️ Google & Pixel bugs fixed

- **Pixel Launcher:** some app icons had clipped corners and rough edges. They're clean now.


## What's new in 3.0.0

3.0.2 lets you arrange the share menu, place app drawer folders anywhere and clear notification dots, and fixes icon packs. See the [3.0.2 release notes](RELEASE-NOTES-v3.0.2.md).

The biggest Pixel Suite release yet:

- 📤 **Share menu tools:** reorder pinned apps and contacts, hide apps and contacts into folders.
- 🖼️ **Pixel Studio, reimagined:** pinch to zoom, an all-new text tool on the picture, the whole picture kept after a crop, a floating colour menu.
- 🎨 **Icon packs** for Pixel Launcher, cut into your icon shape.
- 📞 **Call recording** in the Google Phone app, in any country, without the announcement.
- 🚫 **Ad blocking** system-wide, in Chrome and Google News, plus an ad-free Google feed.
- 🔕 **Do Not Annoy:** silence incoming calls while staying connected.
- 🛡️ **OTA & Store blocker:** keep your system and chosen apps on their current versions.
- ⌚ **Pixel Watch eSIM** setup with a QR code, in any country.
- 🧭 **Navigation buttons** beside the gesture bar, with Circle to Search or Gemini on a long press of Home.
- 🍞 **Toasts:** show every toast at the top, in the middle or at the bottom.
- 💠 **A fresh look:** a redesigned app with search across every setting, and glass rims on Frosted Glass panels.
- 📱 **More Pixel Launchers supported**, and fixes for bugs in Google's own apps.

See the [full release notes](RELEASE-NOTES-v3.0.0.md) for every change.

## 📤 Share menu (Share menu > Share sheet tools)

- **Reorder pinned apps** by dragging; extra pinned rows when one is full. Pinned apps aren't listed twice.
- **Hide apps** into a **Hidden apps** folder, one by one or several at once with **Edit**. Tap a hidden app to share to it; long-press to unhide.
- **Contacts:** reorder pinned contacts, hide contacts into a **Hidden contacts** folder, or fold the whole contacts row away.
- Long app names stay on one line. Folders and panels follow your surface style and theme.
- Google Photos' share page now uses the share sheet's own colours instead of plain white.

---

## 🖼️ Pixel Studio, reimagined

- **Zoom:** pinch to zoom up to 5x and pan, anywhere in the editor. While zoomed, the pen, highlighter and eraser draw right under your finger, and crop corners stay under it. Save and Share are unaffected.
- **All-new text tool:** type right on the picture, live, in your chosen font and colour.
  - Only ✓ saves, in the top bar or on the text's frame; ✕ deletes.
  - A saved text keeps a frame: drag to move it, side handles re-wrap the words, corner handles resize it. Two fingers on a text zoom the picture, like anywhere else.
  - A floating fonts and colours menu above the tool bar or keyboard, compact or full width, that you can drag or flick.
  - Typing on a cropped picture shows the cropped part right above the keyboard.
- **The whole picture after a crop:** other tools keep the picture in place, the cropped part where the box was and the rest softly blurred around it.
- **Crop from any tool:** grab a crop corner from any page and keep dragging.
- **Pen stays inside the crop:** after a crop, strokes stay within the cropped area.
- **Floating colour menu** for the pen and highlighter, in the style of the Doodles menu.
- **The tool bar is always there**, also while a text or sticker is selected.
- **Pen strokes on top** of texts, stickers and Doodles' shapes, on screen and when saved.
- **Sticker grabbers:** resize stickers from their corners, with undo.
- One menu at a time: the pen, colour, text and Doodles menus close each other.
- Doodles: two fingers now zoom and pan the picture; small shapes move without growing. After a crop, new shapes are drawn only inside the cropped part (existing ones can still be moved anywhere).
- Crop only from the four corners, so swiping in from an edge no longer crops by accident.

The new text tool needs Pixel Studio 2.3.001; on other versions, Pixel Studio's own text tool is used.

---

## 🎨 Icons

**Icon packs** (Themes > Choose Icon pack)
- Use any standard icon pack from the Play Store or sideloaded (ADW / Nova / Lawnchair format).
- Covers the home screen, folders, the dock, the app drawer and drawer search.
- Every pack icon is trimmed and cut into the icon shape you chose in Wallpaper & style, with clean, smooth edges in every shape.
- Apps the pack doesn't include keep their own icons, including themed icons. Packs that use Material You colours follow your phone's colours.
- Changes apply live with a smooth crossfade, no launcher restart. Icons are prepared in advance, so scrolling stays smooth.
- Pick one app's icon from any pack: long-press the app > **Change icon** > **Icon pack**, with search and the app's matching icons first. **Reset icon** goes back.

**Colorful icons in the app drawer (Stock)** (Themes > Change icons)
- An option for a stock-looking drawer: with themed icons on, the app drawer, its suggestions, drawer search and drawer folders keep each app's own colours. The home screen stays themed.

---

## 💎 Google apps (Patreon)

Support Pixel Suite on Patreon and sign in inside the app to unlock these. Locked features are clearly marked and stay off until unlocked.

- **📞 Call recording** in the Google Phone app: works in any country, automatic or manual, and without the "This call is now being recorded" announcement. A copy of each recording is saved as M4A, named after the contact and time, in Recordings/Calls or a folder you choose.
- **🚫 Ad blocker:** blocks ad and tracker domains for every app and browser, even with Private DNS on, using the HaGeZi Multi LIGHT, AdAway and EasyList lists, updated daily.
  - **Chrome:** ads on web pages are hidden with EasyList's element rules, so no empty boxes or gaps are left. "Allow ads" and "turn off your ad blocker" pop-ups, sticky ad bars and floating video ads are removed too, and the page scrolls normally again.
  - **Chrome's new-tab feed:** sponsored stories disappear completely as you scroll, and so do the "Is this a good recommendation for you?" prompts.
  - **Google News:** cleaner articles, without ads.
- **📰 Hide ads in Google feed:** sponsored cards in Discover (and the launcher's left page) disappear completely, frame and gap included.

The pass is checked on your phone and works within seconds, no restart.

---

## 🔕 Do Not Annoy

Silence every incoming call while your phone stays connected. Data, Wi-Fi, outgoing calls and messages keep working.
- On Pixels with Pixel's calling stack (Pixel 10 and later), callers hear that your phone is switched off or unavailable. On other phones, calls are declined.
- Emergency calls always ring.
- Each silenced call shows a notification with a **Call back** button and a call log entry.
- Quick Settings tile included.
- **Pixel Watch with LTE:** also turns your watch's own mobile network off and back on, with the **Pixel Suite Watch** app (separate download).

---

## 🛡️ OTA & Store blocker

- **OTA blocker:** stops system update checks and downloads, and removes Software updates from Settings. **Lock factory reset** greys out Erase all data while it's on.
- **Play Store blocker:** chosen apps stay on their current version; the Play Store never updates them. Core Pixel apps are held back unless you choose **Unlock OEM apps**, and uninstalling or disabling them asks for your fingerprint or PIN.

---

## ⌚ Pixel Watch eSIM

**eSIM setup with a QR code** (Google apps > Pixel watch): the Pixel Watch app offers **Scan QR code** under Mobile network, even where Google says "No carrier supported". A one-time $10 purchase, yours to keep on your phone; Patreon is not required.

---

## 🧭 Navigation buttons (Gestures > Navigation buttons)

A hybrid navigation bar: the gesture pill stays, with a button on each side.
- Choose the left and right buttons: **Back**, **Home**, **Recent apps** or none.
- **Hold Home for:** Circle to Search, Gemini or nothing.
- Buttons follow the pill's light and dark colour and hide on the lock screen.
- With the keyboard open, the Back arrow turns down to close it.
- Swipes from the pill still go Home and to Recents. Taps are instant, with roomy touch areas.

---

## 🍞 Toasts (Pixel Launcher > Toasts)

Choose where every toast message appears: **Top** (as before), **Middle**, or **Bottom (Stock)**, where Android puts it. All toasts follow your choice, in your surface style and theme.

---

## ⚙️ Miscellaneous

- **Refresh rate slider:** a 60 / 120 Hz slider under Smooth display in Settings > Display & touch. The screen still drops to its lowest rate when nothing moves.
- **Show FPS:** a live frame counter at the top right for the app in front.
- **Backup & restore** (About and support): save your whole setup to one file (every setting, drawer folders and sorting, renamed apps, custom icons and share menu choices) and restore it anytime, even after clearing Pixel Launcher's storage or a factory reset. Patreon sign-in and the eSIM purchase aren't included; they stay tied to your account, and Patreon features only switch back on with an active Patreon pass.
- **Allow screenshots of secure screens** and **Hide accessibility from apps** are now built entirely on Pixel Suite's own code, with the same behaviour.

---

## 💠 A fresh look

- **Pixel Suite app redesign:** a new home header, colour-coded sections, **search across every setting**, panels that fit the screen, soft frosted scrolling edges, and an **LSPosed scope** guide on each feature page that lists exactly which apps to select.
- **Super Dark-Mode, deeper:** the app's sheets, dialogs, menus and fields share one pure-black palette, and pills and toasts are white on black.
- **Glass rims:** Frosted Glass panels, folders, menus, toasts and dialogs get a soft glass edge in light and dark theme, and Super Dark's soft rim in Super Dark-Mode, now also on Settings pop-ups. Blur Off keeps plain panels.
- **Soft frosted scrolling edges (Frosted Glass)** across the whole Settings app and the screens it opens (Google, Wallpaper & style, Permissions, Digital Wellbeing, Pixel Troubleshooting, Personal Safety), and in the app drawer, where apps fade softly under the search bar as you scroll.
- The app drawer always shows its **All apps** label under the suggestions.
- Open folders show their name in bold, on the left, and folders in the app drawer lift when you hold them, like apps.
- **Remove, Cancel and Uninstall** light up with an outline as an app reaches them, one at a time. Several selected apps fly into them together.

---

## 📱 More Pixel Launchers supported

Pixel Suite now works across more Pixel Launcher versions, including the newest builds with the redesigned app menu. Every feature is loaded on its own, so if a launcher version changes something one feature relies on, the others keep working.
- Pixel Suite's menu options (Create folder, Change icon, Rename, Lock) show on the new Pixel Launcher menu, and Hide app shortcuts works there too.
- Fixed a Pixel Launcher crash when opening an app's menu on newer launcher builds.
- Fixed dragging apps out of the app list, drawer folders and icon label sizing on newer launcher builds.
- Clear all, folder reordering, locked-app and folder protection, and the home screen's **Pixel Suite settings** row are adapted to the changes in newer launcher builds.

---

## 🐞 Bug fixes

- Pixel Studio: after typing a text and pressing ✓, opening Doodles or another tool could add a copy of the text.
- Double tap to sleep: right after a reboot, typing your PIN could turn the screen off.
- Custom and icon-pack icons: swiping an app away no longer briefly shows the stock icon flying back.
- Custom and icon-pack icons: a closed folder's small icons no longer snap to the themed icons at the end of the closing animation.
- Pixel Launcher: after moving several apps at once, Remove or Cancel could overlap Uninstall on the next drag.

---

## 🛠️ Google & Pixel bugs fixed

Bugs in Google's own apps that Pixel Suite now fixes:
- **Pixel Launcher:** themed icons had hard, stepped edges with a thin light rim in every icon shape. They're now drawn smooth, like normal icons.
- **Pixel Launcher:** closing a folder from its second (or later) page with a non-round icon shape (arch, cookie, clover…) blanked the page while the first page's icons trailed outside the folder. Folders now close cleanly from any page, in every shape.
- **Pixel Studio:** dragging a crop corner made a selected text jump around. It stays still now.
- **Pixel Studio:** tapping a text or sticker on the crop page threw away your crop. Your crop is kept.
- **Pixel Studio:** the tool bar disappeared while a text or sticker was selected. It stays.
- **Pixel Studio:** picking a pen could fold the tool bar down to that one pen. Fixed.
- **Pixel Studio:** selecting a text or sticker covered the pen strokes drawn before it. Strokes stay visible.

---

## Features

**Pixel Launcher**
- Drawer folders with their own grids and sorting, adaptive 3×3 / 4×4 / 5×5 home folder grids, and single-app folders.
- Rename apps and change icons (your own pictures or any icon pack); changes show everywhere, including Google search.
- Icon packs, colorful drawer icons, five icon label sizes and Hide app shortcuts.
- Drag to home screen, two-finger drag and moving several apps at once.
- Always-visible Clear all, locked cards in recents and a cleaner landscape recents.
- Navigation buttons beside the gesture bar, and a choice of where toasts appear.

**Privacy & Security**
- Lock apps and folders with your fingerprint or PIN, with blurred previews in recents and protection against uninstalling, disabling or removing them.

**Buttons and gestures**
- Power button flashlight, volume-down camera, three-finger screenshot, double tap to sleep, and tap or double tap to wake 📲.

**Screenshots and photos**
- Pixel Studio: free crop, Doodles (shapes and arrows), zoom, an on-picture text tool and more.
- Google Photos: editable Doodles, working completely offline.

**Themes**
- Super Dark-Mode (pure black), three surface styles (Blur Off, Stock, Frosted Glass) with glass rims, and soft frosted edges.

**Google apps** (Patreon)
- Call recording, system-wide ad blocking (also in Chrome and Google News) and an ad-free Google feed.
- Pixel Watch eSIM setup with a QR code (one-time purchase).

**More**
- Share menu tools, Do Not Annoy, OTA & Store blocker, newest-first file sorting, refresh rate slider, Show FPS, secure-screen screenshots, hiding accessibility or Developer options from apps, and a keyboard bar tweak.

## 🔒 Privacy

Pixel Suite has no ads, analytics or tracking, and the module itself never connects to the internet. The app goes online only to check for updates (you can turn this off), to download the Ad blocker's lists while it's on, and for Patreon sign-in or the eSIM purchase if you use them. Doodles, screenshots, photos and call recordings stay on your phone.

## 📥 Install and scope

**Root + LSPosed API 102 required.** Tested on Pixel 11 Pro with Android 17.

1. Install **PixelSuite-v3.0.2.apk** over your current version.
2. Enable Pixel Suite in LSPosed and grant its app root access.
3. Open Pixel Suite and turn on the features you want. Each feature page has an **LSPosed scope** section listing the apps to select for it.
4. Select those apps in LSPosed, then reboot.

Set up a phone screen lock before using Privacy & Security. Save editor work before changing an editor feature. Call recording may be restricted by your country's laws; obtain any required consent before recording.
